description: This file defines the KpiDecorator class within the OrangeHRM project. The class serves as a decorator for the Kpi entity, providing methods to set related entities such as JobTitle by ID. It utilizes traits for ORM helper functions and is part of a plugin namespace specific to HRM performance features.

classes.name: KpiDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the Kpi entity, providing additional methods to set associated entities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a Kpi entity instance.

methods.name: setJobTitleById
methods.description: Sets the JobTitle of the Kpi entity based on a provided ID.
